theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (v : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ v → ∀ φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (∫ y in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) : Set (Euclid P)), exteriorDerivative (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y v ∂μHE[(d + 1)] = 0) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, ∫ y in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ {y : Euclid P | inner ℝ y (v 0) < t}, exteriorDerivative (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y v ∂μHE[(d + 1)] = ∫ y in {y : Euclid P | y - t • v 0 ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (Fin.tail v))}, (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y (Fin.tail v) ∂μHE[d]
